title: The Last Lantern
author: Quentin Hartwell
blurb: Oscar Almeida, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, has spent seven years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
